abstract: A woman with disseminated choriocarcinoma and with clinical and biochemical evidence of thyrotoxicosis is described. Only a few cases have been previously reported, and works are referred to showing that high levels of human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG) probably are responsible for the thyroid-stimulating activity in patients with trophoblastic disease and clinical signs of thyrotoxicosis.
abstract_ja: 播種性絨毛癌と甲状腺中毒症の臨床的および生化学的所見を示す女性患者を報告する。このような症例は過去にほとんど報告されておらず、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の高値が、栄養膜性疾患で甲状腺中毒症の徴候を示す患者における甲状腺刺激活性の原因である可能性が高いことを示す文献を紹介する。
